scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:adapter && node dist/cli.js validate --tests tests && node dist/cli.js run --adapter reference --tests tests --out reports/reference
scripts.conformance:reference: npm run build && node dist/cli.js run --adapter reference --tests tests --out reports/reference
scripts.conformance:all: npm run build && node dist/cli.js run --adapter all --tests tests --out reports --no-fail
scripts.report: npm run build && node dist/cli.js site --reports reports --out site
scripts.validate:fixtures: npm run build && node dist/cli.js validate --tests tests
